trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I wish I didn’t have to getting up.
trap.right: I wish I didn’t have to get up.
trap.why: Wish + passado, mas have to leva base. O brasileiro mistura com -ing. Wish também pode usar would para irritação.

mcq.q: I wish I **___** to get up early.

fix.wrong: I wish I don’t have to work.
fix.right: I wish I didn’t have to work.
She wishes he would stop shouting.

fix.wrong: I wish I had to not leave.
fix.right: I wish I didn’t have to leave.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I have to get up early.” (I wish… didn’t)
rewrite.answer: I wish I didn’t have to get up early.
